text: 23-year-old female. The patient complains of a pruritic rash on both upper extremities that has been present for 5 months. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Allergic Contact Dermatitis. While I initially suspected this due to the chronicity and location, your denial of new exposures is atypical; however, given the limited history and the specific distribution on the upper extremities, this remains the most likely clinical picture, potentially triggered by a delayed reaction to a substance like jewelry, hair dye, or topical products you may have used months ago.
